{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify the number of completed orders
num_completed = len(df_completed)
print(f"Number of completed orders: {num_completed}")

# Compute conversion rate by channel
df_completed['converted'] = df_completed['converted'].astype(float)  # Ensure numeric
conversion_rate_by_channel = df_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by channel (completed only):")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel)

# Compute the raw difference: email minus paid_search
diff_raw = conversion_rate_by_channel['email'] - conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']
print(f"Raw difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {diff_raw:.4f}")

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
segment_by_channel = df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Customer segment distribution by channel (completed orders):")
print(segment_by_channel)

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_by_segment = df_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by customer_segment:")
print(conversion_by_segment)

# Compute segment-level differences (email - paid_search)
stratified_diff = []
for seg in df_completed['customer_segment'].unique():
    seg_data = df_completed[df_completed['customer_segment'] == seg]
    rate_email = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    rate_paid_search = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff_seg = rate_email - rate_paid_search
    stratified_diff.append(diff_seg)
    print(f"Segment {seg}: email - paid_search = {diff_seg:.4f}")

# Compute weighted average difference by segment size
weights = df_completed['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
weighted_diff = sum(stratified_diff[i] * weights[seg] for i, seg in enumerate(df_completed['customer_segment'].unique()))
print(f"Weighted average difference (by segment size): {weighted_diff:.4f}")"}
